propositions: Rebar does not validate that git-remote-s3 helper (>=0.3.2) is available before attempting to push to s3:// or s3+zip:// remotes, allowing silent store corruption via multiple bundles per ref when the helper lacks IfNoneMatch per-ref locking

Missing or too-old git-remote-s3 helper should cause init and push operations to fail closed early with an actionable error message naming 'pip install nava-rebar[s3]' and the >=0.3.2 minimum, rather than allowing corrupting pushes
S3 mode detection must reuse the existing remote URL resolution seams (push.py line ~418 and init.py's _git remote get-url) with no new config schema changes or redundant URL resolution calls

OptionalDependencyError from the S3 preflight must propagate unconditionally through write_and_push (which lacks try/except) and be explicitly re-raised in push_after_commit's best-effort exception handler to halt writes and prevent store corruption

The preflight guard must be called in three locations: push.py synchronous always path after URL resolution, push.py async arm before detaching child, and init.py _mount_or_create_branch after remote name resolution
